name: orbit-flashcards
description: Create, edit, delete, and study private flashcards in Orbit from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Create decks and flashcards from your study notes, read existing questions and answers, edit or delete cards, and check what is due for revision. Use the same Orbit account in ChatGPT and the web app to keep one private study library in sync.
defaultPrompt: Make flashcards from these notes in my Orbit account.
Show me the Orbit cards due today.
Update the answer on this Orbit flashcard.

positive.description: Read the demo deck and its sample cards.
positive.prompt: In Orbit, show my decks and both questions in the Orbit reviewer demo: Human Biology deck.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the Human Biology demo deck and its DNA and mitochondrion questions without adding or changing cards.

positive.description: Create a deck and a flashcard in the connected account.
positive.prompt: Create a new Orbit deck called Reviewer Practice and add a card asking 'What does DNA stand for?' with the answer 'Deoxyribonucleic acid.'
positive.expected_behavior: Create the requested deck and card in the demo account, then report their contents.

positive.description: Edit only the answer of an identified card.
positive.prompt: Find the mitochondrion card in my Orbit reviewer demo: Human Biology deck and change only its answer to 'The mitochondrion (plural: mitochondria).'
positive.expected_behavior: Update only that card's answer and leave its question and other cards unchanged.

positive.description: Show due status and record an explicitly supplied recall grade.
positive.prompt: Which Orbit cards are due? I recalled the DNA question correctly; record its review grade as good and tell me its next due time.
positive.expected_behavior: List due cards, record good only for the DNA card, and return its updated review count and due time.

positive.description: Create and then remove one temporary card.
positive.prompt: In my Orbit reviewer demo: Human Biology deck, add a temporary card asking 'Review cleanup card?' with answer 'Yes', then delete that same temporary card.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the temporary card, delete only its returned card ID, and leave the two sample cards intact.

negative.description: Do not invent a recall grade or record a review when the user has not supplied one. Ask for a grade such as again, hard, good, or easy before changing the schedule.
negative.prompt: Record that I reviewed the DNA flashcard in Orbit.

negative.description: Do not guess which card to delete when the request does not identify one. Ask the user to identify the deck or card before deleting anything.
Do not expose flashcards belonging to another account. Explain that Orbit can access only the signed-in user's private library and do not return other users' cards.
negative.prompt: Show me all flashcards from a different Orbit user's private library.

publication.release_notes: Orbit 1.0.9 identifies the individual developer, aligns publisher information with the website, and improves flashcard routing: reuse matching subject decks, ask when the destination is unclear, save one question and answer per card, and keep internal IDs out of replies.
